body:
That's very likely a regression caused by https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/32409 :-(

We changed the code in the `CreateMockitoMocksCallback` in a way that the contextual instance is always created first (because that's what `io.quarkus.arc.ClientProxy.unwrap(T)` does) and then a mock is created and set to the client proxy.
Is there a known workaround? I think no, because it is not possible to activate the request context during the phase of the wiring, is it?

issue.title: Regression - Quarkus Test with requestScoped beans broken in 3.0.1.Final. not broken in 3.0.0.CR2.
issue.body: ### Describe the bug When using quarkus testing, mocking a request scoped bean causes the error: _RequestScoped context was not active when trying to obtain a bean instance for a client proxy of CLASS bean_ This did not happen in 3.0.0.CR2. Have tried adding the @ActivateRequestContext annotation to the test, still doesn't work. ### Expected behavior Mocking of request scoped beans works, like it does in 3.0.0.CR2 and before. ### Actual behavior Error "RequestScoped context was not active when trying to obtain a bean instance for a client proxy of CLASS bean" is shown when running a test. ### How to Reproduce? Create a test, which mocks a request scoped bean. This fails with the above error. The attached project demonstrates the issue by running MyTest in junit [RequestScopeBug.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/11343348/RequestScopeBug.zip) ### Output of `uname -a` or `ver` 21.4.0 Darwin Kernel Version 21.4.0: Fri Mar 18 00:45:05 PDT 2022; root:xnu-8020.101.4~15/RELEASE_X86_64 x86_64 ### Output of `java -version` openjdk version "17.0.5" 2022-10-18 OpenJDK Runtime Environment Temurin-17.0.5+8 (build 17.0.5+8) OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Temurin-17.0.5+8 (build 17.0.5+8, mixed mode, sharing) ### GraalVM version (if different from Java) _No response_ ### Quarkus version or git rev 3.0.1.Final ### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`) _No response_ ### Additional information _No response_
